```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6, fig.height = 3, cache = TRUE,
                      message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(spatialss)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(cowplot)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)
library(dplyr)
```

## 加载四川地级市数据

```{r}
sichuan <- load_sichuan()
head(sichuan)
```

```{r}
# 查看数据结构
class(sichuan)
names(sichuan)
```

## Base R 绘图

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=4}
plot(sichuan["export22"],
     main = "2022年四川地级市出口总额",
     key.pos = 1,
     axes = TRUE)
```

## ggplot2 绘制地图

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=4}
ggplot(data = sichuan) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = export22)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "四川省地级市出口总额（2022）",
       fill = "出口额")
```

## 添加城市标注

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=4}
coords <- load_sichuan_coords()
head(coords)

ggplot(data = sichuan) +
  geom_sf(fill = "white", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(data = coords, aes(x = Lon, y = Lat, label = City),
            size = 3, color = "darkred") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "四川省地级市分布")
```

## tmap 专题地图

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
tm_shape(sichuan) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_fill(col = "export22",
          palette = "Blues",
          title = "出口总额") +
  tm_layout(title = "2022年四川地级市出口总额")
```

## tmap 图层叠加

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
tm_shape(sichuan) +
  tm_borders(col = "grey40") +
  tm_fill(col = "export22",
          palette = "YlOrRd",
          title = "出口总额",
          style = "quantile") +
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top")) +
  tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_layout(title = "四川省出口总额",
            legend.position = c("right", "bottom"))
```

## 加载并可视化栅格数据 - 夜间灯光

```{r}
nightlights <- load_nightlights()
nightlights
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 裁剪到四川范围
light_sc <- load_nightlights(crop_to = "sichuan")
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
tm_shape(light_sc) +
  tm_raster(palette = "YlOrRd",
            title = "夜间灯光强度",
            style = "cont") +
  tm_layout(title = "四川省夜间灯光（2015）")
```
